name: AR_CASH_PROCESSING_EXCEPTIONS
description: This table contains error information resulting from cash processing documents.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_ID
columns.description: Exception identifier.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Type of Cash Processing Document associated with the exception.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Cash Processing Document associated with the exception.

columns.name: SOURCE_PROCESS_CODE
columns.description: Process that caused the exception.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Document IO file identifier. Foreign key to DocIO file record.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Exception details. Foreign key to FND_MESSAGES.

columns.name: MESSAGE_CONTEXT_1
columns.description: Additional message context and parameters.

columns.description: Additional message context and parameters.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Current status of the exception: OPEN/RESOLVED.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_NOTES
columns.description: User-entered notes about the exception.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_INFORMATION
columns.description: Additional information related to the exception. For example, space to store parameters of an errored API call.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates type of exception to end user: ERROR/WARNING/INFO.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
